_meta.purpose: Quantitative visual rules for a procedural 3D character generator in the style of the Pokemon anime's Kanto era (Indigo League / Orange Islands / Johto, 1997-2002), with notes on later eras (XY, Sun & Moon, Journeys) and the Let's Go Pikachu/Eevee 3D game models as a 3D reference.
_meta.method: Proportions were measured on official full-body anime artwork and Let's Go VS renders from Bulbapedia's media archive, using a 40-step grid overlay on the figure's bounding box. Colours were sampled from original-series cel screenshots (640x480), digital-era screenshots (1280x720) and official artwork, using median-cut clustering plus position centroids and point sampling. Each value is tagged 'measured' (taken from images here), 'derived' (computed from measured values) or 'estimate' (style convention from viewing many images, not measured one by one). Scanned 1990s art has colour drift, so cel screenshot values are preferred where they disagree.
_meta.head_unit_definition: H = skull crown to chin, excluding hair volume, hats and ahoge. W = face/skull width at eye level, excluding ears and hair. Heads-tall = total standing height (floor to skull crown) / H.

eras.OS_1997_2002: Indigo League, Orange Islands, Johto and films M01-M04. Lead character designer Sayuri Ichiishi, adapting Ken Sugimori's game art. Hand-painted cels until Johto (EP2xx, digital ink & paint from about 2002). Tall, narrow eyes, sharp spiky hair, one hard shadow tone, black lines. This is the TARGET era.
eras.AG_DP: Hoenn/Sinnoh, digital colour. Same designer until DP, then Toshiya Yamada. Rounder faces, slightly larger irises, more saturated digital colours.
eras.XY_2013_2016: Most detailed modern style: thinner lines, gradient irises with 2 highlights, hair highlight shapes, slightly taller teens.
eras.SM_JN_2016_2023: Designer Satoshi Nakano. Simplified to Sugimori's later style: rounder, softer, wider and shorter eyes, fewer lines, sparse face shading, easier to animate.
eras.LGPE_3D: Let's Go Pikachu/Eevee VS renders: the closest official 3D cel-shaded Kanto look, but chibi (kids 3-3.5 heads, adults 5-6). Use as a 3D shading reference, not for proportions.

_notes: Measured (OS-era official art, skull H): Ash 10y ~5.0 (OS) / 5.1 (JN); Sammy (young Oak, 10y, M04) ~4.5; Misty 10y ~5.0-5.2; Gary 10y ~5.8 (tall rival design, an outlier); Brock 15y ~5.7-6.0; Bianca (M05, teen) ~5.3; Melody (M02, teen) ~6.0-6.2; Nurse Joy ~6.4; Officer Jenny ~6.4; Jessie ~7.0; Professor Oak ~5.7 (JN) to 6.2 (OS); James ~7 (slim, tall).
Let's Go 3D renders (H includes hair): Youngster ~3.0, Bug Catcher ~3.5, Lass (teen) ~4.3, Ace Trainer ~5.0, Super Nerd ~5.0, Gentleman ~6.0, Hiker ~3.5 (rotund).
Leg share = crotch height / total height. Anime: preteens 0.40-0.45, adult women 0.47-0.52, adult men 0.46-0.50.
Bulbapedia trivia puts Ash at about 140 cm (4'7"). Use real-world heights per age and derive H = height / heads_tall.

Oak's age: Bulbapedia's anime page gives 50 as of M04. It is fan-derived (the Sammy flashback is 40 years earlier) and not stated officially; an older page said 47. His design (grey hair, eye bags, heavy brows) reads 55-65. Treat him as the 'middle_aged' to 'elder' boundary.

exaggerations: Kids get big heads (4.5-5.2 heads at 10 years vs ~6.5 in reality at that age) and large eyes.
Adult women get very long legs (leg share 0.50-0.52), small heads (6.4-7 heads), narrow waists and small feet in heels or Mary Janes.
Adult men split into lanky (James, Gary-type: 6.8-7.2 heads, narrow) and blocky (Oak, Brock, Lt. Surge, Hiker: big square head, broad shoulders, 5.7-6.2 heads).

Shoes are chunky and oversized on kids and teens: sneaker length 0.9-1.05 H (a real foot is ~0.75 H at 10 years), with thick soles of 0.12-0.18 H. Adult women's shoes are small: foot length 0.85-0.9 H.
Hands are slightly oversized on kids (0.62-0.7 H). Fingers are simple: four tapered fingers and a separate thumb, with no knuckle detail except on men (Brock, Oak).
Necks: kids thin (0.28-0.32 W wide, 0.2-0.25 H long); adult women long and thin (0.3 H long); men thick (0.45-0.55 W).
global_rules.silhouette: Readable from far away: one big shape per garment, high-contrast colour blocks, a hat or hair silhouette that identifies the character. The torso is a simple tapered box. The waist sits high on kids (0.55-0.58 of height from the floor) and at about 0.6 on adult women.

toddler_2_5.belly: slightly round, belly protrudes 0.05 H past the chest
toddler_2_5.source: estimate (OS background kids, Marnie & Paige young Joys, baby Misty flashback, LGPE Youngster as an upper bound of stylisation)

child_6_9.source: estimate interpolated between toddler and the measured 10-year-olds; Max (AG) and Bonnie (XY) read ~4.3

reference_characters: Melody's age group sits at the top end
preteen_10_12.source: measured (Ash OS/JN, Misty OS/JN, Sammy M04, Gary OS)

chest.male: flat and boxy; Brock is broad
chest.female: small bust 0.1 H forward of the ribcage

teen_13_17.source: measured (Brock OS x2, Melody M02, Bianca M05) + estimate

shoe_style_bias.female: heels 0.15-0.2 H or Mary Janes; long boots (Jessie, Jenny knee boots)

body_variants: muscular (Lt. Surge, Sailor: shoulders 2.6-3.0 W, arms 0.5 W thick)
heavy (Hiker, Cue Ball: waist 2.4-2.8 W, belly forward 0.4 H, 3.5-5 heads in LGPE)
adult_30_45.source: estimate (Delia from screenshots; LGPE Rocker/Sailor/Fisherman renders)

middle_aged_45_60.jaw: square, wide; Oak's jaw is about 0.85 W at the mouth line

elder_60_plus.stoop: spine bent forward 8-15 deg at the upper back; head forward 0.2-0.3 H; knees slightly bent 5-10 deg; reduces standing height by 3-6%
elder_60_plus.source: estimate (Blaine OS screenshot, LGPE Gentleman/Gamer renders)

LGPE_3D_reference_heads_tall.note: measured from VS renders (H including hair). Kids in Let's Go are much more chibi than in the anime. For an anime look, use the anime numbers above. To mix the two, take a weighted average (for example 0.7 anime + 0.3 LGPE).

construction._coords: All vertical positions are fractions of H measured down from the skull crown. Horizontal positions are fractions of W from the face centre line.

head_shape.child: Round skull, cheeks full; the jaw curves to a soft rounded chin. W/H 0.86-0.95.
head_shape.teen_adult_female: Oval skull; the jaw tapers to a small pointed chin (V); the cheek line is a gentle convex curve. W/H 0.76-0.82.
head_shape.teen_adult_male: Slightly angular; jaw corners at 0.82-0.86 H; flat chin 0.3-0.35 W wide. W/H 0.78-0.82.
head_shape.blocky_male: Oak, Lt. Surge, Brock: rectangular face, wide jaw (0.85-0.95 W), heavy brow ridge. W/H 0.85-0.9.

landmarks.ear_top: at brow height to upper eyelid height

size_rules.inner_corner_gap: 1.0-1.3 eye widths (OS); up to 1.6 (JN Ash, measured)

Nurse_Joy_OS.note: OS women: very tall, narrow eyes

size_rules.tilt: Outer corner raised 0-5 deg for kids and gentle adults, 8-15 deg for sharp characters (Gary, Jessie, Jenny, rivals), drooping -5 deg for kind elders and Delia-like mothers

structure.upper_lid: The thickest line on the face: 2.0-2.5x the outline weight, a slight arch, overhanging the iris top. It extends 5-10% past the eye white at the outer corner.
structure.lower_lid: Thin (0.6x outline) short stroke covering only the outer 30-50% of the eye bottom, or no stroke at all. The eye white is otherwise closed by the iris and white edge only.
structure.eye_white: pure or slightly warm white #FFFFFF to #F8F8F0; a shadow band under the upper lid (skin-shade or light grey #D8D8E0) 10-15% of the eye height in XY and later; none in OS
structure.iris: A vertical oval 55-75% of the eye width and 75-95% of the eye height, clipped by the upper lid. OS kids: the iris nearly fills the eye (Ash 75%). Adults: 50-60%.
structure.pupil: A darker concentric oval 45-55% of the iris size. In OS it is often merged with a dark iris (Ash, Brock, Delia OS = black/dark-brown eyes).
structure.iris_gradient: OS: flat one tone + pupil. XY onwards: the top 40% is darker (lid shadow), the bottom lighter, with a 1-2 step gradient.

highlights.count: OS: 1 main highlight (sometimes a 2nd tiny dot). XY: 2 (big + small). SM/JN: 1 big + 1 small.
highlights.primary: Pure white oval, 25-35% of the iris width, tall (h:w 1.5), placed upper-outer or upper-left (the same screen side for both eyes, from a key light at upper-left). It overlaps the pupil/iris edge.
highlights.secondary: Small dot 8-12% of the iris width, lower, opposite side.
highlights.OS_Misty_specific: single vertical white streak in the teal iris

structure.colours_by_era: OS: most kids and Delia had black/very dark-brown eyes; Misty teal-green; Jessie blue-violet; James green; Jenny/Joy blue. Digital AG+: Delia amber, Gary viridian; SM+: Ash brown with a visible iris and highlight. Generator iris palette: dark brown #3A2418, brown #6B3A1E, amber #B5651D, hazel #7A6A2A, teal #2E8C86, viridian #2F7D5B, blue #2D4E9E, violet-blue #5A4FA8, grey #6A7480, near-black #1C1A22

lashes.girls_6_12: Upper lid line thickened at the outer third; 1-2 short flicks (length 0.15-0.25 eye width) angled 30-50 deg up/out from the outer corner. No lower lashes (Misty).
lashes.teen_female: 2 flicks + upper lid tapered; optional 1 lower lash at the outer corner.
lashes.adult_female: 2-3 flicks fanning outwards (Joy has 3 thin curls; Jessie has thick eyeliner-like wings that extend past the eye 0.25 eye widths) + 1-2 lower lashes at the outer third. Thicker lid line (2.5x).
lashes.boys_men: No flicks. The upper lid may end in a single short downward tick at the outer corner (Ash, Gary). The lid is straighter and lower, giving a narrower look.
lashes.elder_female: 1 flick or none; eyes smaller; often half-closed smiling arcs

eye_types_by_character.Ash_OS: Tall oval whites, large dark (black-brown) iris filling ~75%, one big white highlight, a thick slightly arched upper lid ending in a downward tick, a short lower stroke. Brows thin and close above. Energetic: brows angle down to the centre when determined.
eye_types_by_character.Ash_SM_JN: Wider and rounder (h:w ~1.3-1.6), brown iris #6B3A1E with a darker top and 1 big + 1 small highlight, simpler lid.
eye_types_by_character.Misty: Tall narrow whites, a teal/viridian iris ~60% width with a vertical highlight, 1-2 lash flicks at the outer upper corner; brows thin arcs.
eye_types_by_character.Brock: Closed-line eyes: each eye is a single thick slightly arched stroke (or an inverted V when smiling), length ~0.2 W, no white and no iris. Sugimori's design note: Brock (Takeshi) was written as someone who rarely smiles, so he was drawn without visible eyes. Heavy bushy brows a short gap above.
eye_types_by_character.Gary_OS: Narrower, angular eyes (h:w ~1.3), outer corners up 10 deg, dark grey-blue iris with a highlight, lids straight on top: a smug look. Brows thin, angled.
eye_types_by_character.Jessie: Almond eyes tilted up 10-15 deg, blue/violet iris ~55% width, heavy black upper lid with 2-3 long wing-lashes, lower lash; bright red lipstick; green sphere earrings.
eye_types_by_character.James: Softer almond eyes, green iris, thin lid, no flicks; slightly droopy when scared.
eye_types_by_character.Delia: Large round friendly eyes (h:w ~1.4), dark (OS) / amber (digital) iris, soft upper lid with 1 subtle flick, gently curved brows; slight smile lines.
eye_types_by_character.Nurse_Joy: Very tall eyes (h:w ~2.3 measured), blue iris, 3 thin curled lashes, gentle downward tilt; a small smile with a pink-red mouth.
eye_types_by_character.Officer_Jenny: Tall eyes with a red-brown/dark iris (OS), strong lid with 2 sharp flicks, an upward tilt (confident); thin arched brows.
eye_types_by_character.Professor_Oak: Small squarish eye whites (h:w ~1.0), tiny dark dot iris, VERY thick brows (thickness ~0.35-0.5 eye height, a wedge shape wider at the inner end), heavy upper lid, an under-eye bag line, a stern frown at rest or a crinkled smile.
eye_types_by_character.elders: Eyes are small (0.07-0.11 H tall), often a dot iris or a closed arc when smiling, drooping lids, 2-3 crow's-feet lines, bags under the eyes, thick white/grey brows (Blaine: bushy white sideburns + mustache).

brows.position: Float 0.04-0.08 H above the upper lid (kids higher, rugged men lower and closer).
brows.length: 1.0-1.2x the eye width, starting above the inner corner

thickness.rugged_men: filled shape 0.15-0.25 eye height thick (Brock, Lt. Surge)

shapes: straight angled down to the centre (determined)
brows.colour: same as the hair shadow tone, or the outline colour for very dark hair

nose.front: Barely drawn: a tiny vertical stroke or small shadow triangle 0.04-0.06 H long, centred at 0.70-0.72 H. Kids: a dot or nothing in close-ups.
nose.three_quarter: Small check mark '<' or 'L' on the far side of the face (Misty, Ash), with a 2-4 px shadow wedge below; the tip projects 0.02-0.04 H beyond the cheek contour.
nose.profile: Small triangle with a straight bridge, a slightly upturned tip for kids and women; longer and straighter for men; Oak and elders get a bigger rounded tip with a nostril dot.
nose.3D_note: Model a soft small nose bump (projection 0.04 W on kids, 0.07 W on men). Outline it only when it silhouettes; draw the front-view nose as a decal (a shadow wedge) instead of a mesh-edge outline.

mouth.closed_neutral: A single line 0.22-0.32 W at 0.82-0.84 H; kids slightly upturned; men flatter; Oak's frown has down-turned corners and a short underlip line.
mouth.open_talk: Rounded D/trapezoid 0.2-0.3 W wide, 0.06-0.12 H tall, dark interior #8A2B2B, a tongue #E8787A filling the lower 40%.
mouth.shout_laugh: Huge open mouth up to 0.5 W wide and 0.2-0.25 H tall (Misty yelling, Ash cheering), the jaw dropping 0.1 H
mouth.grin_teeth: A white upper-teeth band filling the top 35-50% (Ash JN grin); teeth are never individually separated except for gag faces.
mouth.cat_mouth: the 'w' mouth is used for cheeky gag moments
mouth.lips: Not drawn for kids or men. Adult women: OS keeps them mostly lineless; Jessie has bright red lips #D8232C, and Jenny/Joy sometimes show a tinted short mouth. A lip tint is a female-adult signal.
mouth.shading: No lip shading; the mouth interior uses 2 flat tones (dark + tongue).

ears.shape: Simple C-curve, 0.18-0.22 H tall (kids proportionally larger, 0.22), with one inner curl line (a '6' or '?' shape). Big rounded ears on Oak and Brock.
ears.position: top at brow/upper-lid level, bottom at the nose line, set at 0.48-0.52 of the head depth
ears.visibility: often hidden by hair for girls (Misty's are visible; Joy's and Jessie's are partially covered)

cheek_marks.Ash: One mark per cheek: a horizontal zig-zag 'Z'/lightning shape of 2 kinks, 0.5-0.7 eye width long, placed just below the outer half of each eye at ~0.66 H, drawn in the outline colour at 0.8x weight. Iconic: reserve it for the hero/player or use a different mark shape for NPCs.
cheek_marks.blush_hatch: 3-4 short parallel diagonal strokes (45 deg) on the cheek, 0.1 W long, in red-brown #C8504A, for embarrassment, or in OS gag shots.
cheek_marks.blush_fill: Soft ellipse 0.2 W x 0.07 H under the eye, pink #F4A0A0 at 40-60% opacity. Modern eras use it more; OS uses it only for embarrassment or illness.
cheek_marks.freckles: Rare in Kanto anime; for country/outdoorsy kids use 3-6 small dots per cheek in the skin shade colour, 0.01 H diameter, arranged in a loose arc across the nose bridge.
cheek_marks.Oak: small red mark beside the nose in OS artwork (a red tone accent)

aging_signals.child: large eyes low on the head, round cheeks, short nose, high forehead (hairline at 0.2-0.25 H), no lines
aging_signals.teen: eyes slightly smaller and higher, jaw begins to define, longer neck
aging_signals.adult: eyes at the middle, defined jaw (men squarer), a visible nose shadow, female lip tint, eyelash flicks (women), Adam's apple (occasional, men)
aging_signals.middle_aged: eye bags (one short curved line under each eye, 0.6 eye width), nasolabial lines (a short 0.08 H stroke from the nose wing toward the mouth corner), heavier brows, greying temples (hair colour blended 30-50% to #A9A9A9), a slightly receding hairline (hairline moved up 0.05 H), thicker neck
aging_signals.elder: smaller eyes (0.07-0.11 H), 2-3 forehead lines (0.4 W long, gently curved), 2-3 crow's-feet strokes per eye, deep nasolabial folds, jowl lines at the jaw corners, sagging lids, white/grey hair (#E8E8E8 base, #B8B8C0 shade) or baldness (Blaine, Gambler), big bushy white brows/mustache/beard as identity shapes, sunken lips (a thin upper-lip line)
aging_signals.line_count_rule: The number of facial line strokes beyond the eyes, brows and mouth: kids 0-1 (nose), teens 1-2, adults 2-3, middle-aged 4-6, elders 8-14

design_language.principle: Hair is designed as a few big solid clumps with sharp pointed tips and a strong silhouette; it reads as one helmet-like volume with spikes, not as strands. Inner detail is 2-6 short separation lines that start at a clump edge and stop before the parting/crown.
design_language.volume_offset: The hair silhouette sits 0.08-0.25 H outside the skull (spiky boys 0.2-0.4 H at the spike tips; Jessie's mane 3-4 H long).

clump_counts.long_hair: 3-6 large ribbon-like clumps with tapered ends

design_language.tips: Tips are sharp triangles; clump edges are straight-to-slightly-convex curves; tip angle 20-40 deg; adjacent clumps overlap at 20-40% of their width.
design_language.bangs: 3-6 pointed fringe clumps over the forehead, reaching from the brow line to the upper lid; a central clump is often split to show the forehead. A cap pushes the bangs flat with spikes poking out at the sides (Ash).
design_language.ahoge: A single upward or back-curling strand 0.15-0.3 H long, used on Delia (OS digital and later), the Psychic class (LGPE) and gag/airheaded or bright characters; avoid it on serious adults.
design_language.hairline_and_parting: A parting is rarely drawn; when shown it is a single line plus a 'V' at the crown.
design_language.shading: Base + 1 hard shadow tone (the shadow sits under bangs, at the nape and on the side away from the light, covering 25-40% of the hair). A highlight band is OPTIONAL: OS uses it on glossy dark/long hair (Erika's blue-black bob has a wide pale-blue band; Jessie has a pink sheen streak; Sabrina), not on Ash, Misty or Brock. XY uses jagged highlight shapes. SM/JN use almost none.
design_language.highlight_band_shape: A crescent following the skull curve at 25-35% down from the crown, 0.06-0.1 H thick, broken into 3-6 zig-zag segments matching the clump edges; colour = base hue, value +20-30%, saturation -10%.

iconic_styles.Ash: Black hair with a blue-teal cast (#22303A base, #0E1A20 shade). Visible under the cap: 3 bang spikes over the forehead, 2 spikes per side flaring out over the ears, 3-5 spikes at the back of the neck sticking out under the cap band. Without the cap it is an unruly mop of ~10 spikes.
iconic_styles.Misty: Orange (#F57B14 OS cel; #D37C44 JN), short, with a SMALL side ponytail on the upper-left of her head (viewer's right) tied with a blue/red tie, 3-4 spiky ponytail tips; jagged bangs of 5-6 points, side locks to the jaw.
iconic_styles.Brock: Dark brown (#4A3102 OS cel; #614B31 JN), a full radial spiky crown of 14-18 upward and outward spikes, very short sides.
iconic_styles.Gary: Auburn/brown, 12-15 long upward-swept spikes, longest 0.5 H above the crown, side spikes swept back; a bad-boy rival silhouette.
iconic_styles.Jessie: Crimson/magenta (OS cel ~#C0263E; scan #8E1619; dark pink in early eps). Bangs swept back from the face into one enormous mane that falls behind and curls into a hook/spiral at the end; total length ~3.5 H; 1 pink highlight streak.
iconic_styles.James: Periwinkle/lavender (#8A88AF light, #585A71 shade), a layered bob to the chin with long fringe locks framing the face.
iconic_styles.Delia: Auburn/mahogany (#9E471C, shade #6A3723), side-swept bangs, a long ponytail tied LOW at the nape and draped over one shoulder, one ahoge strand on top.
iconic_styles.Nurse_Joy: Pink-red (#F83E3C on OS art), puffy bangs + TWO LARGE LOOPS hanging at the sides (each loop a tube folded into a ring ~0.8-1.0 H in diameter), a white nurse cap with a red cross.
iconic_styles.Officer_Jenny: Teal/blue-green (#2B9296 OS art; earlier cels bluer), shoulder-length, with 3-4 sharp spikes flaring out at the sides behind the ears; police cap.
iconic_styles.Professor_Oak: Grey (JN #B2ADA1, shade #7F776D; OS art drawn khaki/light brown), a sharp spiky crest sticking up at the top front and back, flat at the sides, receding temples.
iconic_styles.Tracey: Black (OS)/olive (digital), short messy mop held by a salmon headband.
iconic_styles.Erika: Blue-black chin-length bob with straight bangs and a red hairband; wide pale highlight band.
iconic_styles.Sabrina: Very long straight dark green-black hair, hime cut with straight bangs.
iconic_styles.Blaine: Bald crown with a bushy white fringe around the sides/back (side tufts flaring 0.3 H out); white mustache.
iconic_styles.Bianca_M05: Brown, two big upward flicks at the sides resembling Latias's wings, under a white beret.
iconic_styles.Melody_M02: Long dark-red-brown hair (#8E231D) under an orange bandana, side strands blowing in the wind.

colours._note: Hex values sampled from OS cel screenshots where possible ('cel'), else official art ('art'). Shade = base x V0.6-0.78; hue shifted 3-10 deg toward red for warm hues.

crimson_magenta_Jessie.source: art scan #8E1619/#530509, brightened to cel value; estimate

colours.usage_rules: About 60-70% of townsfolk use natural colours (black, browns, auburn, blonde, grey). Unnatural hues (pink, teal, purple, periwinkle, green, bright red) are reserved for named/major characters, specialists and villains, roughly 1 in 4 NPCs. Hair saturation stays 0.45-0.85 for colours; blacks are tinted (blue or brown), never pure #000.

skin._note: Pokemon anime skin is warm peach-orange. Tone varies per character, not per region, except tanned islanders (Orange Islands Joys are darker). One base + one hard shade.

tones.name: brown (Lt. Surge, Giovanni under warm light, Kiawe-type)

shade_rule.derived_from: Misty JN, Delia, Brock OS, Bianca, Blaine sample pairs
shade_rule.edge: Hard (a step function); in 3D use a ramp with a 1-3% smoothstep width so it doesn't alias
shade_rule.placement: Under hair bangs on the forehead (a jagged shadow echoing the bang tips), under the chin onto the neck (the whole neck is often in shadow), under sleeves and shorts hems, the inner arm, the side of the face away from the key light (a thin 10-20% sliver on 3/4 views). OS faces in close-up often have NO face shading except under the bangs.

skin.highlight_rule: No skin highlights in OS/SM/JN. XY occasionally adds a small cheek/nose highlight; avoid it.

game_palette_FRLG_sprites._note: Exact pixel palettes shared by nearly all FireRed/LeafGreen trainer sprites (Sugimori-supervised Kanto remake). A 4-step ramp, useful as a check on the game look.

outline.colour: Near-black. OS cel lines read as #1A1414 to #2A2020 (warm black). Use #1E1A1C for outer lines. Coloured trace lines (iro-tore) are used for the shadow/highlight borders inside hair and skin in some cuts; in 3D, skip them or use the shade colour x0.7.
outline.absolute_at_1080p: silhouette ~3 px for a character 600 px tall (0.5% of height), interior ~1.5-2 px. Lines thinner in XY, thicker and rounder in SM/JN.
outline.variation: Slight taper at stroke ends (OS hand inking); thicker on the dark side and under overhangs. In 3D: inverted-hull or screen-space edge detection with width scaled by depth, plus a 1.3x multiplier on silhouette edges facing away from the light.
outline.creases: Garment folds are drawn as 1-3 short lines per joint (elbows, knees, waist, armpits) that stop before crossing the whole garment.
outline.game_sprite_note: FRLG sprites use #000000/#000018/#101010 outlines, plus a darker hue-shifted tone (#684848 on skin) for interior lines; the anime uses near-black throughout.

cel_shading.tones_per_material: 2 (base + shadow). Optional 3rd = highlight on hair (glossy characters), shoes, Poke Balls, belts and plastic.
cel_shading.light: Key light from upper-left-front (about 45 deg azimuth, 45 deg elevation); shadow coverage 25-40% of each form.
cel_shading.shadow_shape: Shadow shapes are simplified: large flat shapes with sharp edges, following the garment folds. No ambient occlusion and no gradients on characters (OS). Rim light only in film/action cuts (a thin warm rim in M01-M04 dramatic lighting).

cloth_shade_multiplier.whites: x0.80-0.85 with a slight blue-grey shift (e.g. #E8ECED -> #C3C5C4)

cel_shading.special_lighting: Night scenes multiply the whole palette by a blue/purple tint (about #8090C0, multiply) and keep 2-tone shading; sunset scenes use an orange multiply (#F0B080) + a warm shadow tone.

principles: Characters are more saturated and higher-contrast than backgrounds. OS backgrounds are hand-painted poster colour/watercolour with no outlines and soft gradients; character cel colours are flat with black outlines. Keep the average character saturation about 1.2-1.5x the background's at a similar value.
Each design uses 3-5 main colour blocks: 1 dominant (40-60% of the area), 1 secondary (20-30%), 1-2 accents (5-10%), plus skin and hair.

Heroes and kids use primary/secondary hues: red, blue, yellow, green, orange (Ash's red-white-blue + green accents echo Pokemon Red/Blue). Earth-tone helpers (Brock: green, orange, brown). Villains use black/white/red (Team Rocket) or sinister purple/orange suits (Giovanni).
Values: the face is always the lightest warm area near the top. Hair is darker than skin by 30-60% value except for blondes/pinks. The shirt/top contrasts with the hair.
Avoid pure black (#000) and pure white for large garment areas. Whites are #F2F6F2-#FFFFFC; blacks are #1E2228-#2A2E31 with a hue tint.

generator_recipe_summary: 1. Pick age group and sex, then sample heads_tall, leg_share, shoulder/hip widths in W, hand/foot sizes in H from the ranges; add +-3% noise per NPC.
2. Build the head: W/H by age; eye line by age; eye size by age/sex; eye shape h:w 1.5-2.0 (OS); tilt by personality; iris 55-75% of the eye width; 1 big highlight (upper-left) + optional small one.
3. Brows by archetype; nose as a small decal/shadow wedge; mouth line at 0.82-0.84 H; ears C-shaped with one curl.
4. Hair: choose a template (spiky/bob/ponytail/long/bald) and sample clump count and spike length; base + 1 shadow tone; a highlight band only for glossy dark or long hair.
5. Skin: choose from the 10 tones; shade = V x0.8, S +0.1, hue -4 deg.
6. Outfit: 3-5 colour blocks, the dominant hue saturated; accessories in accent colours; chunky shoes for kids.

7. Render: 2-tone cel ramp with a hard edge, a near-black warm outline at a 1.0 silhouette / 0.6 interior ratio, a thick upper eyelid (decal), no AO on characters, background painted softer and less saturated.

_meta.purpose: Clothing design language of the Pokemon world (Kanto anime focus) for a procedural clothing catalogue.
_meta.sources_summary: Bulbapedia wikitext (Ash's clothing, Misty, Brock, Nurse Joy, Officer Jenny, Team Rocket uniform, Tracey, trainer class pages, the X and Y clothing list and Trainer customization). Official anime artwork (OS/JN). Pokemon Let's Go Pikachu/Eevee VS renders (3D Kanto trainer classes). FireRed/LeafGreen trainer sprites, whose exact palettes were extracted. OS cel screenshots.
_meta.hex_confidence: 'sprite' = exact FRLG pixel palette (light/base/shade as drawn). 'cel'/'art' = sampled from anime images. 'estimate' = by eye from renders. FRLG sprite hexes come from a limited 15-colour palette and are slightly muted; for the anime look, raise saturation 10-20%.

what_reads_as_pokemon: Practical outdoor kids' clothing with one bold hero colour: caps, short-sleeved jackets or vests over tees, cuffed jeans or shorts, fingerless gloves, chunky high-top sneakers, a backpack. Clothes for walking routes.
Strong colour blocking with 3-5 flat colours, mostly primaries (red/blue/yellow/green) for the young. Contrast trim (white collars and cuffs, gold piping) on hero jackets.

Each NPC is readable by one silhouette prop or garment that names their job or hobby (Trainer class logic): net + straw hat = Bug Catcher, enormous backpack = Hiker, rod + life vest = Fisherman, lab coat = Scientist, miko robes = Channeler, hard hat = Engineer, leather + mohawk = Biker, gi + headband = Black Belt, cape = Juggler, ringmaster coat + whip = Tamer.

Pokemon motifs are used sparingly: a Poke Ball half-circle or circle logo on caps, bags and chest panels (Ash's later hats and bags all carry a stylised Poke Ball or 'C' logo), Poke Ball clips on belts, a Pokemon-shaped bag (Misty's Spheal bag), and kigurumi costumes (PokeManiac). Never all-over prints in the Kanto era.
The clothes are clean, simple and non-branded, and look new. Damage, logos and fine patterns are rare (one stripe, one emblem). Folds are minimal: 1-3 crease lines per joint.

Gender styling is classic Japanese-anime 1990s: girls in crop tops, shorts, skirts, suspenders, ribbons and Mary Janes; boys in caps, jackets, jeans and sneakers. Adult women's uniforms use skirts, puffed sleeves and gloves; adult men's use vests, ties and boots.
Professions wear iconic uniforms with zero variation (every Nurse Joy and every Officer Jenny is identical). Background townsfolk wear ordinary late-90s Japanese casual clothes.

kalos_XY_fashion.why: Kalos is based on France. Director Junichi Masuda chose France for its focus on fashion and refined aesthetics, and the generation's theme was 'Beauty' (the meaning of 'Kalos' in Greek). Art directors Ken Sugimori and Takao Unno visited France to research it rather than lean on cliches. Player customisation (new in X/Y) supports the self-expression/fashion theme.

Detective_Pikachu_2019.takeaway: Live-action Ryme City shows how 'Pokemon' translates to real-world fashion: ordinary contemporary urban clothes (anoraks, trench coats, hoodies, denim) with Pokemon motifs kept subtle, often colour-matched to the partner Pokemon (for example Tim's green-checked/earth-tone layers; Lucy Stevens in a yellow/teal journalist look with a deerstalker-like detective hat on Pikachu). Use it as evidence that a realistic catalogue still works if the colour pairing with the partner Pokemon is strong.

kids_toddler_to_preteen: Cover the torso: no crop tops or bare midriffs for under-13s (change Misty-style crop tops to full-length tops); shorts and skirts at mid-thigh or longer; swimwear as one-pieces, rash guards and board shorts.
Use bright primary/secondary colours (S 0.6-0.9), 1-2 playful motifs (stripe, star, Pokemon-silhouette patch, Poke Ball logo) and big readable shapes.
Oversized chunky sneakers (0.9-1.05 H long), visible white socks, a cap or sun hat, a backpack.
Typical sets: cap + tee + shorts + sneakers; overalls + tee; sundress + straw hat; scout uniform; Pokemon onesie hoodie; school uniform; rain set (yellow raincoat + boots).
No high heels, no makeup or lipstick, no jewellery beyond hair accessories and a simple pendant.
Proportional fit: garments sit loose (0.03-0.06 H off the body); sleeves end mid-upper-arm; shorts end mid-thigh; socks to the ankle or mid-calf.
teens: Sporty or casual: vests over tees, track jackets, jeans, skirts at the knee, knee socks; first hints of a personal style (punk, preppy, outdoorsy).
Moderate colours with one saturated accent.
adults: Profession-coded outfits for named NPCs; casual muted palettes for extras.
Women: blouses, cardigans, skirts or slacks, aprons, sundresses; heels allowed for uniforms and glamorous characters.
Men: shirts, vests, slacks, work wear, suits.
elders: Muted, warm, comfortable: cardigans, vests, waistcoats, slacks with a crease, long skirts, shawls, kimono/samue, flat caps, fedoras, cane.
Palette: browns, greys, olives, deep reds and indigos at S 0.2-0.5, V 0.35-0.7; one accent (a red tie, a gold watch chain).
Looser fit (0.05-0.08 H off the body), longer hems (skirts mid-calf, trousers full length), flat shoes, sandals or slippers.
Identity props: cane (~0.5 of height), glasses, a pocket watch, a sun hat, a straw hat for gardeners, a shawl.
